name: Mark Morrison
category: Marine GIS and scientific mapping practitioners
story: NIWA identified Dr Mark Morrison as project leader for the Bay of Islands Ocean Survey 20/20 marine biodiversity survey, undertaken in 2008–2010. The programme produced seabed maps, biological samples and imagery for a public web-portal release in December 2010.
The historical record establishes the project-lead role but does not assign development of the portal's web code or individual GIS datasets to Morrison.
